consequence.statement: A v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret that sets spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion to "v1" is rejected by the API server because that enum value was removed.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, change engineVersion on affected ClusterExternalSecrets to a value the new schema still allows.

assertion.statement: In the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecret schema, the enum value "v1" was removed from spec.externalSecretSpec.target.template.engineVersion, so the API server rejects v1beta1 ClusterExternalSecrets that set engineVersion to "v1".
